name: SupportNinja (Partner)
desc:
Customer Service Representative II (Seasonal, dates not listed) | $16/hr + $1,500 Project Completion Bonus | Inbound Email and Chat Support, with some phone No Sales Expectations
Company: SupportNinja
Industry: Customer Service

What Your Day Will Look Like:
Supporting customers with questions about their e-file, refund status, tax forms. 

Soft Skills
- Empathy and patience
- Staying calm with upset customers
- Clear writing and grammar
- Problem solving
- Attention to detail
previous tax experience is a huge help
assessment: Yes. Candidates access an instant interview through Alpharun at the link provided in the posting. This is a recorded asynchronous interview rather than a live conversation, completed online before any human review.
skills:
Actual Minimum Requirements

Education Minimum: Not listed in the posting
Required Experience: At least 2 years of customer service, preferably in a call center, contact center, or customer support
Preferred Experience: Chat support and handling escalated customer issues. Tax experience will take priority. 

Required Skills:
- Strong verbal and written communication and grammar
- Handling escalated or complex customer issues
- Comfortable with computers, CRM systems, and support platforms
- Basic troubleshooting
- Problem solving and critical thinking
- Managing several priorities in a fast-paced setting
- De-escalation skills
- Accurate documentation

This role is ideal for someone who:
- Has 2+ years of call center or customer support experience
- Writes well and is comfortable with chat support
- Stays calm with frustrated customers
- Wants seasonal work with a bonus for finishing strong

Not a Good Fit for someone who:
- Has less than 2 years of customer service experience
- Needs a permanent, year-round job
- Struggles with grammar in written replies
- Gets stressed by escalated calls or high volume
notes:
Expected Application & Interviewing Process:
1. Submit application
2. Complete SupportNinja's instant online interview here: https://alpharun.com/i/hDOrpnGOTSC5JzZ8GpojG
3. You will either talk to a live recruiter or receive an assessment after the AI interview. 
Watch for an email inviting you to a prescreening
4. Depending on how the interview went, expect an email with next steps


Top 10 Resume Keywords
- Customer service
- Call center
- Phone, email, and chat support
- Escalation handling
- Tax, finance, banking, experience
- account documentation
- Troubleshooting
- Knowledge base research
- Meeting KPIs
- Multitasking

4-5 Interview Questions for this Role:
- Tell us about your customer service and chat experience.
- A customer is angry and wants a supervisor. How do you handle it?
- How do you keep your written replies clear and professional during a busy shift?
- Tell us about a time you solved a complicated customer problem. What was it, what did you do, and what was the result?
- Tell us about a time you met a tough performance goal. What was the goal, what did you do, and how did it turn out?
other:
Pay, Shift, Benefits, Background, Drug Test Information, and Career Pathway:
-Pay: $16/hr, plus a $1,500 project completion bonus.
-Shift: Must have availability for any shift based on business needs. Can be discussed in final interview, offer stage.
-Benefits: Not listed for this seasonal role. Ask in the interview.
-Equipment Provided: Yes, company-provided.
-Felony Friendly?: Case by case
-Drug Test: No
-Notes: This is a seasonal project, and the posting doesn't list start or end dates, so ask in the interview. The $1,500 bonus is paid for finishing the project, so participants should plan to stay through the end. The posting lists the location as Texas, so confirm which states are eligible before referring participants. The first interview is an instant online interview, so participants should have a quiet space and good internet ready. Training length and camera requirements are not listed.
-Career Pathway: Reasonable inferred path: Customer Service Representative II → Senior Customer Service Representative → Team Lead → Customer Support Supervisor. This role builds multichannel support, escalation, and CRM skills.
training: discussed in interview/ofer stage. must be available for any shift
